svg.title: The distinct axes 0, 1 specify the chosen external direction and polarization. The comparison construction establishes the first estimate at scale r + μ, and the second on the subfamily μ ≤r at scale r; packaging all admissible symbols and masses into these two families gives common constants. The estimates apply to the same mass μ, without shifting it to a preferred radius. Let Aμ = {μ < r ≤1}. In four dimensions the unit ball has volume π2/2, so polar integration gives Z
